parameters.content: Replace this No-Op with your notifier (Slack / Email / Telegram). It receives { count, digest }. This flow is READ-ONLY and schedules nothing that can bypass SELL AGENT's consent, eligibility, opt-out, quiet-hours or emergency-stop controls — the local API enforces those.
